question: T12 (task-fec995a65f376f5a): arrow keys on a Scrolling block's Wave Intensity range: the value, the undo steps and the focus. On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and a Text block added after it, made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/3/10; R the Scrolling block alone). The Scrolling block selected, Edit, Design ('open'), a press on Wave Intensity, then a press on the range's thumb at the value it shows (no input fires) and real arrow keys (one DevTools session, rawKeyDown and keyUp), the state read 60 ms after each key, at its gap and 1.2 s after the last; then Escape ('go') and Cmd+Z, a read after each. K: 90, ArrowRight 3 times 1200 ms apart, then ArrowLeft once (no thumb press before it). L: 90, ArrowRight 3 times 100 ms apart (about 230 ms apart with the reads between). M: in Mobile View (the frame 428 wide) 90, ArrowRight twice 1200 ms apart. R: 180 (the press at the range's end), ArrowRight once, then ArrowDown twice 1200 ms apart. R1 ran K, L, M with other plans (KLUWMV) and R with TNR, R2 in the other order (VMWULK, RNT). Nothing saved: every session left by Exit Without Saving.
readsAre: reads: as CAP-T12TOPFALL (layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section, the section rows in the view shown, the line, Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' the panel's Wave Intensity value). keys: for each arrow-key step, v0 (the value before), states ([name, state]: value is the range's value; focus is the focused element, isRange true when it is the Wave Intensity range; undo [Undo on, Redo on]; lines each Scrolling block's drawing height on the page), and inputs (the page's input, change and pointer events on the range, ms from the first).
answer: Each arrow key moves Wave Intensity by one step of 30, Right up, Left and Down down (Up not read), and fires input then change. The range keeps the focus through every key, and after the press on its thumb (the panel is not drawn anew).

Keys 1.2 s apart are an undo step each: K 90 then Right 3 times (120, 150, 180) then Left (150): Escape, Cmd+Z gives back 180 (1/2/7/26), Cmd+Z again 150 (1/2/6/26). R 180, Down twice (150, 120): Cmd+Z 150, 180, then the section as built. M in the phone view the same: 90, 120, 150 (1/2/5/10, 1/2/6/10, 1/2/7/10), Cmd+Z 120 then 90.
Keys under a quarter of a second apart are one step: L 90 then Right 3 times about 230 ms apart (180): Cmd+Z gives back 90 (1/2/5/26), Cmd+Z again the section as built.
Right at the end (180) changes nothing and fires nothing: no step.

The rows follow the presses' rules: a key that grows the line takes its rows; a one-step fall by a key lets them go as a one-step press fall does (K Left 180 to 150: 1/2/7/26 to 1/2/6/26, the Text block staying at 5/2/7/10, as CAP-T12TOPFALL P).
R1 and R2 read alike in every read and key state (Undo and Redo at a plan's start apart, which stay on from the plan before).
Not read: where between 0.25 and 1.2 s keys stop joining one step; Page Up, Page Down, Home and End; keys on Item Spacing and Text Size; Shift with an arrow; Tab into the range.

localGuesses.written: none written before the reads; ours on main draws the panel again after the first key's change, so the range loses the focus and the next arrow keys move the selected block
